Create a 16:9, 7-slide data analysis report PPT in English, targeted at LLM industry professionals (R&D, product, investment).

This deck should be data-driven, clearly presenting the current LLM market usage landscape, competitive dynamics, and emerging trends.

Use the 7 slide titles provided in the `slides` array of `task_input.json` exactly as given, in order, as the title for each slide.
Slide 2 (Top 10 Models) must use a table or chart to present the ranking data.
Slide 3 (Provider Market Share) must use a pie chart or bar chart to show the share distribution.
Do not fabricate any data or statistics not found in source_brief.md.


## Data Sources

1. **Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md`**  for all the subject-matter text, data tables, statistics, and figure references you may use in the presentation.
2. **Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json`**  for **structural requirements**: deck metadata (slide count, aspect ratio, audience, tone) and a per-slide outline (id, title, objective) that your presentation must follow.

## Output Requirements

Save the final PPT to `/app/output/final_deck.pptx`.

Only the correctly saved final file is needed — no additional explanation is required.

---

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or "wait for user confirmation" instructions, make a professional judgment and proceed.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies fields such as `deck.tone` or `deck.audience`, use them to guide template, color palette, and style choices; otherwise, use your professional judgment.
3. **Do not deploy or share** — no deployment, PDF export, share links, or other post-delivery steps are needed.
4. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

# The 2025 LLM Usage Landscape: Real-World Data from OpenRouter

## Data Source
OpenRouter is one of the largest LLM API aggregation platforms, capturing real usage data from millions of users. The data below is sourced from the OpenRouter Rankings page (https://openrouter.ai/rankings) and covers the most recent week of March 2025.

## Weekly Model Usage Trends

![March 2025 – March 2026 OpenRouter weekly token usage stacked bar chart (total growing from ~2T to ~26T)](./assets/chart_top_models_trend.png)

## This Week's Top 10 Models

![This week's LLM Leaderboard Top 10](./assets/table_leaderboard.png)

| Rank | Model | Provider | Weekly Token Usage | WoW Change |
|:---:|------|------|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | MiMo-V2-Pro | Xiaomi | 3.96T | +165% |
| 2 | Step 3.5 Flash (free) | Stepfun | 1.49T | +1% |
| 3 | MiniMax M2.7 | MiniMax | 1.29T | +253% |
| 4 | DeepSeek V3.2 | DeepSeek | 1.24T | +9% |
| 5 | Claude Sonnet 4.6 | Anthropic | 1.04T | -0% |
| 6 | Claude Opus 4.6 | Anthropic | 995B | +2% |
| 7 | Gemini 3 Flash Preview | Google | 972B | +3% |
| 8 | GLM 5 Turbo | Zhipu (z-ai) | 968B | -6% |
| 9 | MiniMax M2.5 | MiniMax | 909B | -30% |
| 10 | Grok 4.1 Fast | x-ai | 599B | +32% |

**Key Findings**:
- Chinese providers hold 6 of the top 10 spots (Xiaomi, Stepfun, MiniMax ×2, DeepSeek, Zhipu)
- Xiaomi's MiMo-V2-Pro leads by a wide margin at 3.96T tokens, with 165% week-over-week growth
- MiniMax M2.7 posted the strongest growth at +253% week-over-week
- Anthropic's two models (Sonnet 4.6 + Opus 4.6) combine for roughly 2T tokens, but growth has stalled

## Provider Market Share (by Token Volume)

![Provider market share trend (stacked area chart)](./assets/chart_market_share.png)

![Provider market share ranking](./assets/table_market_share.png)

| Rank | Provider | Weekly Token Volume | Market Share |
|:---:|------|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | Xiaomi | 1.31T | 25.9% |
| 2 | Google | 594B | 11.8% |
| 3 | Anthropic | 555B | 11.0% |
| 4 | MiniMax | 429B | 8.5% |
| 5 | OpenAI | 400B | 7.9% |
| 6 | Stepfun | 341B | 6.8% |
| 7 | DeepSeek | 334B | 6.6% |
| 8 | Zhipu (z-ai) | 326B | 6.5% |
| 9 | x-ai | 195B | 3.9% |
| 10 | Others | 563B | 11.2% |

**Key Findings**:
- Xiaomi leads decisively at 25.9%, more than double the second-place Google
- Combined Chinese provider share: Xiaomi + MiniMax + Stepfun + DeepSeek + Zhipu ≈ 54.3%, exceeding half the market
- OpenAI ranks only fifth at 7.9%
- The market is highly fragmented — no single provider exceeds 30%

## Fastest-Growing Models

| Model | Provider | WoW Growth |
|------|------|:---:|
| MiniMax M2.7 | MiniMax | +253% |
| MiMo-V2-Pro | Xiaomi | +165% |
| Cline (coding agent) | Independent developer | +128% |
| Hermes Agent | Nous Research | +92% |
| Ampere | Ampere | +576% |
| Codex | OpenAI | +112% |

## Top Apps (by Daily Token Consumption)

![Top Apps ranking](./assets/table_top_apps.png)

| Rank | App | Description | Daily Token Volume |
|:---:|------|------|:---:|
| 1 | OpenClaw | AI productivity assistant — "The AI that actually does things" | 829B |
| 2 | Kilo Code | VS Code AI coding assistant | 271B |
| 3 | Claude Code | Anthropic's CLI coding tool | 78B |
| 4 | Cline | VS Code autonomous coding agent | 69.1B |
| 5 | Janitor AI | Character roleplay chat | 29.2B |
| 6 | ISEKAI ZERO | AI adventure game | 28.8B |
| 7 | Descript | AI video/podcast editor | 27B |
| 8 | Hermes Agent | Nous Research's AI agent | 19.2B |
| 9 | Roo Code | VS Code AI coding assistant | 11.8B |
| 10 | Scripty | Newly launched tool | 9.95B |

**Key Findings**:
- The top 4 apps are all **AI coding tools** (OpenClaw, Kilo Code, Claude Code, Cline)
- AI coding agents have become the single largest LLM consumption scenario
- Entertainment/roleplay apps (Janitor AI, ISEKAI ZERO) still hold a notable presence
- OpenClaw consumes 829B tokens per day — nearly 3× the second-place app

## Industry Trend Observations

1. **Chinese Models Break Through Globally**: On OpenRouter, an international platform, Chinese provider models now account for over half of all usage. Xiaomi's MiMo series, DeepSeek V3, and MiniMax's M2 series hold a significant cost-performance advantage.

2. **Flash/Turbo Variants Outpace Flagship Models**: Step 3.5 Flash, GLM 5 Turbo, Gemini 3 Flash, and other "fast and affordable" models see far higher usage than their flagship counterparts. Users are voting with their feet — in real-world applications, speed and cost often matter more than peak performance.

3. **AI Coding Agents Dominate Usage**: 5 of the top 10 apps are coding tools. This reflects the largest commercial value proposition for LLMs today — helping developers write code.

4. **A Highly Fragmented Market**: No single model or provider monopolizes the market. The top 10 spans 8 different providers, signaling that competition remains fierce and the landscape is far from settled.

import os
import collections
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_LEGEND_POSITION
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

# Helper function to add formatting to paragraph
def add_bullet(tf, text, size=18, bold=False, color=None):
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(size)
    p.font.bold = bold
    if color:
        p.font.color.rgb = color
    return p

# --- SLIDE 1: Title ---
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
slide.shapes.title.text = "The 2025 LLM Usage Landscape: Real-World Data from OpenRouter"
slide.placeholders[1].text = "Data Source: OpenRouter Rankings (latest week of March 2025)\nHeadline Metric: Over 26T tokens processed this week."

# --- SLIDE 2: Top 10 Models ---
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
slide.shapes.title.text = "This Week's Top 10 Models"

table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(11, 5, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(4.5))
table = table_shape.table
headers = ["Rank", "Model", "Provider", "Weekly Token Usage", "WoW Change"]
data = [
    ["1", "MiMo-V2-Pro", "Xiaomi", "3.96T", "+165%"],
    ["2", "Step 3.5 Flash (free)", "Stepfun", "1.49T", "+1%"],
    ["3", "MiniMax M2.7", "MiniMax", "1.29T", "+253%"],
    ["4", "DeepSeek V3.2", "DeepSeek", "1.24T", "+9%"],
    ["5", "Claude Sonnet 4.6", "Anthropic", "1.04T", "-0%"],
    ["6", "Claude Opus 4.6", "Anthropic", "995B", "+2%"],
    ["7", "Gemini 3 Flash Preview", "Google", "972B", "+3%"],
    ["8", "GLM 5 Turbo", "Zhipu (z-ai)", "968B", "-6%"],
    ["9", "MiniMax M2.5", "MiniMax", "909B", "-30%"],
    ["10", "Grok 4.1 Fast", "x-ai", "599B", "+32%"]
]

for i, header in enumerate(headers):
    table.cell(0, i).text = header
for row_idx, row_data in enumerate(data):
    for col_idx, cell_data in enumerate(row_data):
        table.cell(row_idx + 1, col_idx).text = cell_data

table.columns[0].width = Inches(1.0)
table.columns[1].width = Inches(3.5)
table.columns[2].width = Inches(3.0)
table.columns[3].width = Inches(2.5)
table.columns[4].width = Inches(2.333)

txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(6.2), Inches(12.333), Inches(1.0))
tf = txBox.text_frame
p = tf.add_paragraph()
p.text = "Highlight: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2-Pro tops the list with 3.96T tokens."
p.font.bold = True
p.font.size = Pt(20)
p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 102, 204)

# --- SLIDE 3: Provider Market Share ---
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
slide.shapes.title.text = "Provider Market Share Breakdown"

chart_data = CategoryChartData()
chart_data.categories = ['Xiaomi', 'Google', 'Anthropic', 'MiniMax', 'OpenAI', 'Stepfun', 'DeepSeek', 'Zhipu', 'x-ai', 'Others']
chart_data.add_series('Market Share (%)', (25.9, 11.8, 11.0, 8.5, 7.9, 6.8, 6.6, 6.5, 3.9, 11.2))

chart = slide.shapes.add_chart(
    XL_CHART_TYPE.PIE, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(6.5), Inches(5.5), chart_data
).chart
chart.has_legend = True
chart.legend.position = XL_LEGEND_POSITION.RIGHT
chart.plots[0].has_data_labels = True

txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(7.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(5.333), Inches(5.5))
tf = txBox.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True

add_bullet(tf, "Key Rankings:", size=22, bold=True)
add_bullet(tf, "• Xiaomi: 25.9%\n• Google: 11.8%\n• Anthropic: 11.0%\n• MiniMax: 8.5%\n• OpenAI: 7.9%", size=18)
add_bullet(tf, "")
add_bullet(tf, "Chinese Providers Surge:", size=22, bold=True)
add_bullet(tf, "• Combined share of Chinese providers exceeds 54%.", size=18, color=RGBColor(0, 102, 204))
add_bullet(tf, "")
add_bullet(tf, "Note: Provider-level market share represents the total market across all models/apps (including those outside the top 10). Individual provider volumes may differ from summing top-10 model tokens.", size=14)

# --- SLIDE 4: Shifts in the Market Landscape ---
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
slide.shapes.title.text = "Shifts in the Market Landscape"

txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(6.0), Inches(5.5))
tf = txBox.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True

add_bullet(tf, "1. Dominance of Chinese Models", size=20, bold=True)
add_bullet(tf, "• Chinese models (Xiaomi, Stepfun, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Zhipu) now hold over 54% combined market share on this international platform.", size=18)

add_bullet(tf, "2. Stalled Growth for Anthropic", size=20, bold=True)
add_bullet(tf, "• Anthropic's growth has stalled despite maintaining two models in the top 10.", size=18)

add_bullet(tf, "3. Preference for Speed and Cost", size=20, bold=True)
add_bullet(tf, "• Flash/Turbo 'fast and affordable' variants far outpace flagship models in real-world usage.", size=18)

if os.path.exists('/app/benchmark/assets/chart_top_models_trend.png'):
    slide.shapes.add_picture('/app/benchmark/assets/chart_top_models_trend.png', Inches(6.8), Inches(1.5), height=Inches(4.5))

txBox2 = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(6.8), Inches(6.2), Inches(6.0), Inches(1.0))
tf2 = txBox2.text_frame
tf2.word_wrap = True
add_bullet(tf2, "Weekly token usage trend shows growth from ~2T to ~26T, underscoring a rapidly expanding market.", size=16)

# --- SLIDE 5: This Week's Rising Stars ---
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
slide.shapes.title.text = "This Week's Rising Stars: Fastest-Growing Models"
tf = slide.placeholders[1].text_frame

add_bullet(tf, "Fastest-Growing Models:", size=24, bold=True)
add_bullet(tf, "• MiniMax M2.7: +253%", size=20)
add_bullet(tf, "• Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro: +165%", size=20)
add_bullet(tf, "• Cline (coding agent): +128%", size=20)
add_bullet(tf, "")
add_bullet(tf, "Drivers Behind the Surge:", size=24, bold=True)
add_bullet(tf, "• Incredible cost-to-performance ratio offered by newly released models.", size=20)
add_bullet(tf, "• Widespread adoption of agentic workflows requiring multiple iterative LLM calls without breaking budgets.", size=20)
add_bullet(tf, "• The rise of autonomous coding tools driving specialized, high-growth API consumption.", size=20)

# --- SLIDE 6: App Ecosystem ---
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
slide.shapes.title.text = "App Ecosystem: Who's Calling These Models"

table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(5, 4, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(3.0))
table = table_shape.table
headers = ["Rank", "App", "Description", "Daily Token Volume"]
app_data = [
    ["1", "OpenClaw", "AI productivity assistant", "829B"],
    ["2", "Kilo Code", "VS Code AI coding assistant", "271B"],
    ["3", "Claude Code", "Anthropic's CLI coding tool", "78B"],
    ["4", "Cline", "VS Code autonomous coding agent", "69.1B"]
]

for i, header in enumerate(headers):
    table.cell(0, i).text = header
for row_idx, row_data in enumerate(app_data):
    for col_idx, cell_data in enumerate(row_data):
        table.cell(row_idx + 1, col_idx).text = cell_data

table.columns[0].width = Inches(1.0)
table.columns[1].width = Inches(3.0)
table.columns[2].width = Inches(5.333)
table.columns[3].width = Inches(3.0)

txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(4.8), Inches(12.333), Inches(2.0))
tf = txBox.text_frame
tf.word_wrap = True
add_bullet(tf, "Analysis of Trends:", size=24, bold=True)
add_bullet(tf, "• AI coding assistants are becoming the largest usage category.", size=20)
add_bullet(tf, "• The top 4 apps are heavily developer-centric.", size=20)
add_bullet(tf, "• OpenClaw commands immense volume (829B tokens/day), significantly ahead of competitors.", size=20)

# --- SLIDE 7: Key Insights and Industry Implications ---
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
slide.shapes.title.text = "Key Insights and Industry Implications"
tf = slide.placeholders[1].text_frame

add_bullet(tf, "1. Chinese models now hold a dominant share in the global market (>54%).", size=22)
add_bullet(tf, "2. AI coding agents are the single largest LLM consumption scenario.", size=22)
add_bullet(tf, "3. The model market is highly fragmented with no outright winner.", size=22)
add_bullet(tf, "4. Affordable and fast models (Flash/Turbo variants) far outpace flagship models in usage.", size=22)

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)
prs.save('/app/output/final_deck.pptx')
print("Successfully generated /app/output/final_deck.pptx")
